description: Remove ONE video from a Tutor AI assistant: the tutor stops using it and its knowledge is deleted from the tutor. The video stays in the library. Refused when the video isn't bound to the tutor, when it is the tutor's last video (use panda_delete_ai_assistant to delete the tutor), and while the video is still being processed by the tutor (queued/processing — try again when it finishes). Returns {assistant_id, video_id}.

video_id.description: Video ID to remove from the tutor (one per call)

name: panda_remove_tutor_video
title: Remove Tutor Video
